verdict.rationale: An immigration-services platform with a public website could reasonably publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so the axis applies. The probe found https://www.legalos.ai/llms.txt returns HTTP 404, and no OpenAPI spec exists at any candidate path. None of the documentation describes agent-oriented docs; it consists of marketing pages, calculators and blog posts.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
